staticText.text:
Build your potential | Writing descriptive lists

When we write descriptions, we often include lists. Look at this list:In my bedroom, there is a bed, a small table and two windows.We use there is because the first item on the list (a bed) is singular.We use a comma (,) between the first items on the list. Before the last item, we write and.
